name: httprobe / httpx - Probe for Live HTTP(S) Services
description: httprobe (and the more featureful httpx) take a list of hosts/subdomains and probe which answer on HTTP and HTTPS, returning live URLs. Essential glue between subdomain enumeration and content discovery - it filters thousands of candidate hosts down to the ones actually serving web apps worth scanning.
notes:
=== HTTPROBE (simple) ===
  cat subdomains.txt | httprobe
  # Probe non-standard ports too:
  cat subdomains.txt | httprobe -p http:8080 -p https:8443

=== HTTPX (recommended, richer) ===
  httpx -l subdomains.txt -o live.txt
  # With status, title, tech, length:
  httpx -l subdomains.txt -sc -title -td -cl
  # Only 200s:
  httpx -l subdomains.txt -mc 200
  # Follow redirects + probe common ports:
  httpx -l subdomains.txt -fr -ports 80,443,8080,8443,8000

=== TYPICAL PIPELINE ===
  subfinder -d <domain> -silent | httpx -silent | nuclei
  # subdomains -> live web -> vuln scan

=== FEED INTO CONTENT DISCOVERY ===
  httpx -l subs.txt -silent | while read u; do feroxbuster -u "$u"; done

=== ALTERNATIVES ===
  httprobe  # minimal, fast
  httpx     # status/title/tech/screenshots
  fping/nmap -p80,443  # host-level, less HTTP-aware

recommended.note: Amass is another upstream subdomain source.
Pipe live URLs into nuclei for vuln scanning.
Run content discovery on each live host.

defense.why_it_works: Probing sends ordinary HTTP(S) requests to candidate hosts. It is reconnaissance that blends with normal web traffic, especially at low rates.
defense.prerequisites: A list of candidate hosts/subdomains; network egress to targets.
defense.impact: Reveals the live web attack surface, focusing later attacks.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1595.002] Many root requests ("GET /") across many vhosts/subdomains from one source in a short window; requests to hosts with no prior traffic; default tool User-Agents.
defense.artifacts: Web/CDN/WAF logs showing fan-out probing; spikes of HEAD/GET / to many hostnames.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=web uri_path="/" 
| stats dc(host) as hosts count by src_ip
| where hosts > 50
defense.sentinel_kql:
let probes = _Im_WebSession
| where UrlOriginal endswith "/"
| summarize Hosts=dcount(DstDvcHostname) by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m);
probes | where Hosts > 50
defense.prevention: WAF rate limiting; block known scanner User-Agents; reduce exposed subdomains; monitor for fan-out probing; use allowlists on sensitive vhosts.
